Major Challenges

THE PRESSURES
OUR ISLANDS
ARE FACING.

Empower Kiribati exists because the headwinds are real. These four challenges shape every programme, partnership, and policy conversation we step into.

Data soon

Climate Change

Rising seas, salt intrusion, and intensifying storms put coastal villages and food systems under constant pressure.

Our Work

FOUR PILLARS,
ONE ISLAND
ECOSYSTEM.

We don't run isolated programmes. Each pillar is a different way of caring for the same outcome — communities that can author their own future, on their own atolls, in their own language.

Empowering Leaders & Communities

We strengthen local capability and leadership pathways so communities can lead change on their own terms.

Read more →

Building Partnership for Impact

We build trusted relationships with ministries, councils, and NGOs to coordinate and sustain investment.

Read more →

Creating Conditions for Innovation

We back experimentation and support entrepreneurs to develop locally relevant business models.

Read more →

Enabling Digital Participation

We grow trust in the digital world by strengthening safety, standards, and digital confidence on every atoll.

Read more →

The Future

WE ARE BUILDING
TOGETHER.

By 2030, our goal is a self-sustaining ecosystem where digital trust and economic opportunity reach every citizen of Kiribati — built by I-Kiribati, for I-Kiribati.

Resilience

Climate-adaptive strategies in every community we work with.

Opportunity

Thriving local entrepreneurs and new island-based markets.

Sustaining

An ecosystem that grows independently of any single donor.

Digital Trust

Safe and confident digital participation for every atoll.
